scope: Post-hoc descriptive diagnosis of one fixed run; no causal branch attribution

metrics_parser.name: analyze_metrics
metrics_parser.interface: Official Prometheus parser stdout decoded as JSON

controller.scope: Only records with the exact test namespace

watch.snapshot_basis: Latest preceding records in watch JSONL file order; separate from controller cache

rest_api_errors.note: analyze_rest.py reports arrival-window and process-lifetime counters separately. Error-level logs and internally handled HTTP conflicts/retries describe different observables; final claim outcomes are recorded in the workload.

interpretation: Inventory is visible Sandbox status, not the instantaneous queue or physical container state.
Watch snapshots use preceding file records and are a separate observer from the controller cache.
Timestamp differences compare embedded object timestamps with local watch observation timestamps; they do not isolate a lifecycle stage.
Individual cold fallbacks cannot be assigned to queue-empty versus PodIPs-grace expiry from these records.
Retain the run in the registered full comparison; healthy-inventory and depletion views are descriptive diagnostics.
